VUME Projects:
1. Spartan Poker Website:-
Description: Spartan poker is our parent organization. Current spartan poker website was developed by external agencies. Now, we are developing this website In-house. This project include Frontend website, Backend CMS, and Reports management.
Role: I have gather all project requirements with Marketing team, Setup Laravel project, Integrate SOAP API, Architect Backend structure, Dynamic Menu, Fixed UI Bugs, Code review, Lead Team of four Member (2 Dev, 1 UI Dev, 1QA), Setup project on AWS EC2 Instance for staging
Technologies Used: Laravel 8, MySQL, Bootstrap, HTML, Webengage, SOAP API Integration, Git, Infinity for product management, Nginx
Status: On Staging Server
2. iGaming Website:-
Description: This project include Frontend website, Backend CMS, and Categories games integration using backend. We are developing this for Poker Daddy Casio.
Role: I have gather all project requirements with Marketing team, Setup Laravel project, Integrate SOAP API, Architect Backend structure, Fixed UI Bugs, Lead Team of four Member (2 Dev, 1 UI Dev, 1QA)
Technologies Used: Laravel 8, MySQL, Bootstrap, HTML, REST API Integration, Git, Infinity for product management, Nginx
Status: Under Development

3. Aio.games Blog:-
Description: Spartan poker started multi gaming platform. I have setup it's blog using Wordpress. Theme was purchased but I have customized theme.
Role: Setup project on AWS EC2 Instance for staging, Wordpress installation, Theme installation, Theme customization, Redirect blog.aio.games to aio.games/blog
Technologies Used: Wordpress, MySQL, Bootstrap, HTML, Nginx
Status: Live

Harayana (Product Based Company)
Key Points:
• Worked closely with product team to develop new requirements like redemption process and user purchase and bonus distribution flow on the basis of user's game play activities.
• Defined Credit/Debit system in Adda52 product for all chips transactions.
• Worked with Compliance team to resolve user queries for Purchase and redemption at early stage.
• Scaled system internal transaction (Bonus distribution) as well as gateway transactions up to 100 TPS by implement queuing system
• Worked with Finance team to validate reconciliation report and bad debt.
• Handled cross platform team of product support, resolved bugs and provide root cause analysis
• Design database schemas for entire product and implement index to optimize query speed.
• Introduced automated marketing tools into Adda52 and give free hand to marketing teams. Implement marketing tools using Rabbit MQ queuing system. Tools: Gamooga, WebEngage, HasOffers, Appflyer
• Created Data lake in Snowflake and Pipeline using Hevo tool for Mysql, and Mongo data. Also Perform ETL operations on Snowflake.
• Developed CMS and Website using Laravel, Redis, Queue, Command, Multiple Mysql DB Connections
